recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-12421 unless a future Financial Management decision changes these insurer element names again.
issue_request: FHIR-12421 was a Published/Persuasive Financial Management change request for DSTU2 asking to rename ClaimResponse.organization and EligibilityResponse.organization to .insurer to match ExplanationOfBenefit.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-12421 was found. Historical commits 2b302c46098ecd1360c1ab099b15d0e199e068ae and ecb8f4eec5bdd0d9a2cefbd997c3913a92588b08 changed the ClaimResponse and EligibilityResponse example/spreadsheet source paths from organization to insurer in November 2016.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes ClaimResponse and CoverageEligibilityResponse, lists the old EligibilityResponse as removed, and maps CoverageEligibilityResponse=EligibilityResponse. The current StructureDefinitions and active search-parameter bundles for ClaimResponse and CoverageEligibilityResponse use insurer, and ExplanationOfBenefit also uses insurer. Jira neighborhood, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no related or conflicting final decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already implements the requested rename and preserves the intended alignment with ExplanationOfBenefit.
